description: Personal creator and technical education hub focused on TypeScript, AI agents, verifiable web protocols, and the Portaless, Verared, Gerarion, and Tokenless ecosystem.

props.title: TypeScript, AI, Agents & Web Architecture without black boxes
props.subtitle: I am Geroi Loyola. I build open-source web tools and publish practical engineering guides on modern TypeScript, verifiable protocols for AI agents, and resilient web architecture.

props.text: Four pieces of one open ecosystem

props.items:
server :: Portaless :: Modern Astro-based web CMS with strict CSP (zero unsafe-inline), native visual editor (Visual Elements), ThemePack v2 dual-mode, SQLite/D1 persistence, and Node, Cloudflare Pages, or GitHub Pages deployment. :: span=2 :: featured
package :: Gerarion :: [Editable] Dedicated space to explain the problem Gerarion solves, its core architecture, and how it connects with the rest of the ecosystem.
bot :: Tokenless :: [Editable] Dedicated space to document Tokenless purpose, architecture, and practical real-world use cases.
shield :: Verared :: Open trust infrastructure, verifiable cryptographic identity (did:apw), Web Bot Auth, and Local Trust Protocol in 7 standalone packages (@verared/* on npm). :: span=2 :: featured

props.text: Every piece in the ecosystem enforces explicit boundaries, zero circular dependencies, and full portability: start free on GitHub Pages and move to Cloudflare Pages or Docker self-hosting without rewriting your content.

props.items:
package :: TypeScript & clean boundaries :: Designing decoupled packages, explicit contracts, and zero circular dependencies across repositories.
bot :: AI Agents, MCP & Web Bot Auth :: Connecting MCP clients under atomic permissions and authenticating web agents with cryptographic signatures.
server :: Web Architecture & strict CSP :: Getting the most out of Portaless from scratch: editing the home page visually, choosing runtimes, and eliminating inline scripts.

props.text: This hub runs 100% on Portaless (starter profile + Visual Elements blocks). Follow public ecosystem repositories on GitHub (github.com/geroiloyola) or edit this block whenever you want to publish official contact channels.
